command_line:
set -eu
cat > inspect_results.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
ann <- read.csv(args[1], check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
wanted <- ann[ann[["Gene Name"]] %in% c("rhlI","rhlR") | ann[["Locus Tag"]] == "PA14_35160",
              c("Locus Tag","Gene Name","Product Name"), drop=FALSE]
inspect_one <- function(path, label) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  stopifnot(inherits(x, "DESeqResults"))
  em <- as.data.frame(S4Vectors::mcols(x))
  desc <- if ("description" %in% colnames(em)) {
    paste(paste(rownames(em), em[["description"]], sep="="), collapse=" | ")
  } else {
    ""
  }
  pieces <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(wanted)), function(i) {
    locus <- wanted[["Locus Tag"]][i]
    if (!(locus %in% rownames(x))) return(NULL)
    vals <- as.data.frame(x[locus, , drop=FALSE])
    data.frame(
      source=label,
      object_class=class(x)[1],
      result_description=desc,
      locus=locus,
      gene_name=wanted[["Gene Name"]][i],
      product_name=wanted[["Product Name"]][i],
      vals,
      check.names=FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors=FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, pieces)
}
out <- rbind(inspect_one(args[2], "res_1vs97.rds"),
             inspect_one(args[3], "res_1vs98.rds"))
write.table(out, file="contrast_diagnostics.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na="NA")
